name: Kizugawa (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Kizugawa city emblem in blue and white: a blue disc bearing white stylised leaves and a curved stroke.
history: Municipal flag of Kizugawa, a city in Kyoto Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 12 March 2007.

features.role: Kizugawa city emblem — a blue disc bearing white stylised leaves and a curved stroke
